integrity: Exact Legendre recurrence proof and strict barycentric positivity for all degrees; standalone finite rational checks are supplementary, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only S^2 and the signed P1/P2 modulation of the ball-Poisson kernel for 0<r<1. Bounded literature search cannot prove priority; no higher-dimensional claim.
title: A three-constraint positivity cone for quadratically modulated spherical Poisson kernels
